items.question: How many federal-level entities took part in the commissioning phase when the Government Services Bus (GSB) started?
items.gold: Ten entities at the federal level took part in the GSB commissioning phase.
items.fact: GSB commissioning phase began with ten federal entities

items.question: How many transactions did customers carry out through the Government Services Bus (GSB) in 2019?
items.gold: Customers carried out 57.6 million transactions via GSB in 2019.
items.fact: GSB recorded 57.6 million customer transactions in 2019
